summary: Implemented patch-level transforms and coordinate output for GridPatchDataset (MONAI #1500). Changes: (1) monai/data/utils.py: added iter_patch_position, which yields (patch, position) with each patch's start coordinate in the unpadded array; iter_patch now wraps it; added to __all__. (2) monai/data/grid_dataset.py: GridPatchDataset gained transform (applied to the tuple of patches per grid position, map_items=False) and with_coordinates (default False, yields (patches, coords) when True; coords are not transformed). (3) tests/test_grid_patch_dataset.py: new tests for default output, coordinates, coordinate/content match, patch transform, and transform not touching coordinates. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and ./runtests.sh --quick are unverified. No commit made. Note: with_coordinates defaults to False to avoid breaking existing callers, which differs from the PR's 'breaking change' checkbox.
